items.text: Claim reference CL-4471-D — status update. The assessor reviewed the photographs of the water damage in the upstairs hallway and has asked for the plumber's invoice before we can approve the drying works. Please note you cannot override the excess on this policy; the £350 will be deducted from the final settlement as stated in section 4.2. Your case handler, Denise Okafor, is on leave until 14 March and won't reply to emails in the meantime, so anything urgent should go through the claims line on 0800 118 2244.

Booking confirmation — Larkspur House Hotel, Room 12 (garden view), 3 nights from 18 April. Total £414, breakfast included, free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival.

The card on file was declined on the second attempt, so we've held the room provisionally until 9 April. If the balance isn't settled by then the reservation will be released automatically. You can update payment details from your account page or call reception between 8am and 9pm.

A few practical notes. Check-in opens at 3pm and the front door is locked after 10pm, so if you expect to arrive late please let us know and we'll leave a key in the lockbox — the code goes out the morning of your stay. Parking behind the hotel is £9 per night and there are only six spaces, first come first served.

We don't forward post or parcels to guests, and we can't accept deliveries larger than a shoebox. Do not reply to this email address; it isn't monitored. For anything at all, use the contact form on the website or ring the main number listed there.
Onboarding checklist, week one: collect laptop and badge from IT on day one, complete the data protection module by Friday, and book a 20-minute intro chat with each member of your immediate team.

Ticket #88213 — Onboarding: payroll access. Raised by Priya Raman, People Ops. New starter Tom Aldridge begins Monday and needs a payroll login before his first pay run on the 28th. The standard permission template should cover it, but note that HR admin rights override the default read-only setting, so someone from Finance needs to approve the elevation. Do not reply to this ticket directly — it feeds into the Ops queue and replies get lost. Updates go to priya.raman@northfieldgroup.co.uk or the People Ops channel.
Please forward the signed tenancy agreement to the lettings team once the landlord has countersigned; we can't progress the deposit protection until it's on file.

Car hire excess reimbursement: the prompt from our finance team was to settle claims within ten working days, but yours has taken three weeks — sorry about that. The £72 is in your account as of this morning.

Onboarding checklist — second week. Confirm your emergency contact details in the staff directory and finish the fire safety walkthrough with the building manager. Managers should review the probation objectives template before the end of week two and share it with the new starter; you can override the suggested targets where the role needs it. The IT helpdesk will chase any outstanding kit requests on Friday morning.

Storm damage claim 2291-B: the assessor's report is attached and the settlement figure has been approved at £1,840, less the policy excess. Do not reply to the assessor's email directly — all correspondence goes through the claims team.

Hotel booking record — confirmation LRK-90877. Guest: M. Boateng. Two nights, 22–24 May, twin room, rate £149 per night including VAT. The booking was made under a corporate account tied to Halverson Reid Ltd, so any changes to dates or occupancy must be authorised by the account administrator; the front desk can't override the corporate rate once it's confirmed. Breakfast is not included in this rate, but guests can add it on arrival for £12.50. Cancellation is free up to 72 hours before check-in, after which the first night is charged.
Reminder for the onboarding session on Thursday: bring photo ID and your P45 if you have one, and please forward any questions to people.ops@brightwell.co.uk beforehand.
